Row.Text: Electricity
Nothing turns without something to burn. Have 4 Coal or Oil Resources, in any combination.
4 Resources of fuel hasten Electricity — a share of its research is already complete.
Urbanization
The crowded city still needs somewhere to breathe. Build City Parks in 3 settlements.
A City Park on a Breathtaking tile hastens Urbanization — a share of its research is already complete.
Combustion
What the earth kept, the engine age digs up. Extract an Artifact.
An extracted Artifact hastens Combustion — a share of its research is already complete.
Industrialization
One town gives up everything else to feed the works. Have a Factory Town with 3 Resources assigned to it.
A Factory Town with 3 Resources hastens Industrialization — a share of its research is already complete.
Radio
Every broadcast is also a chance to listen in. Run 3 Espionage actions this Age.
3 Espionage actions hasten Radio — a share of its research is already complete.
Flight
You cannot fly over a world you have never seen. Reveal the whole map.
A fully revealed map hastens Flight — a share of its research is already complete.
Mass Production
The line only moves as fast as the rails that feed it. Have 2 settlements connected by Railroad.
2 settlements on the rail network hasten Mass Production — a share of its research is already complete.
Computation
Teaching and calculating on one block. Have a Laboratory and a Schoolhouse on the same tile.
A Laboratory beside a Schoolhouse hastens Computation — a share of its research is already complete.
Mobilization
The whole war moves at the speed of the air arm. Defeat 3 units with Air units this Age.
3 kills from the air hasten Mobilization — a share of its research is already complete.
Armor
The line breaks where the armour reaches the headquarters. Defeat an enemy Commander this Age.
An enemy Air unit shot down hastens Armor — a share of its research is already complete.
Aerodynamics
Three shapes in the air teach more than three of one. Have a Biplane, a Trench Fighter and a Bomber at the same time. Unique replacements count.
A Biplane, a Trench Fighter and a Bomber hasten Aerodynamics — a share of its research is already complete.
Nuclear Fission
The atom is split in a lecture hall long before a desert. Build Oxford University.
Oxford University hastens Nuclear Fission — a share of its research is already complete.
Rocketry
A launch needs an airfield and a laboratory in the same place. Have an Aerodrome and a Laboratory in your Capital.
Your Capital's launch complex hastens Rocketry — a share of its research is already complete.
Political Theory
Every people argues its own case first. Research a node in your civilization's unique civics tree.
Your own civilization's civics hasten Political Theory — a share of its research is already complete.
Globalism
No one is left off the table. Be engaged in diplomacy with every leader you have met.
Dealings with every leader you have met hasten Globalism — a share of its research is already complete.
Nationalism
A nation at war wants a reason it can name. Declare a Formal War.
A Formal War hastens Nationalism — a share of its research is already complete.
Capitalism
Money sits where the sea route meets the rail head. Have a Stock Exchange adjacent to both a Port and a Rail Station.
A Stock Exchange between Port and Rail Station hastens Capitalism — a share of its research is already complete.
Militarism
The state stands behind its walls everywhere at once. Have Defensive Fortifications in all your Cities.
Fortifications over every city hasten Militarism — a share of its research is already complete.
Hegemony
Rule shows in what you are allowed to build. Build 3 Open-Air Museums.
3 Open-Air Museums hasten Hegemony — a share of its research is already complete.
Liberalism
Liberty is what a long quiet buys. Be at peace with every major civilization on turn 20 of the Modern Age.
Peace with every major civilization hastens Liberalism — a share of its research is already complete.
Progressivism
Reform carries the country with it. Hold +4 War Support against your opponent.
+4 War Support hastens Progressivism — a share of its research is already complete.
Radicalism
A creed that thrives on enemies never lacks for them. Be at war with 2 major civilizations at once.
War against an opposing Ideology hastens Radicalism — a share of its research is already complete.
Absolutism
Some rule is made plain by what it removes. Raze 2 settlements.
2 razed settlements hasten Absolutism — a share of its research is already complete.
Centralism
The plan decides what the countryside is for. Have 5 Farming or Fishing Towns.
5 Farming or Fishing Towns hasten Centralism — a share of its research is already complete.
Socialism
Housing for all of them, not a showpiece for one. Have a Tenement in all your Cities.
A Tenement in every city hastens Socialism — a share of its research is already complete.
